# useExecLogs=true + wrong git user/password in URL userinfo.
# Clone uses go-git (not shell exec), so [exec] may be absent; still enable the
# flag and assert the password sentinel never appears while ***@host is logged.

git-authfail-start

cp .apinfra.secret .apinfra

exec apinfra
stderr 'http://\*\*\*@127.0.0.1:18081/repo'
! stderr 'GitBadPassSentinel99'
! stderr '\[exec\].*GitBadPassSentinel99'
stderr 'git authentication failed'
stderr 'done duration='

! exec grep -R --exclude='.apinfra*' GitBadPassSentinel99 $HOME

git-authfail-stop

-- .apinfra.secret --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
repo=http://baduser:GitBadPassSentinel99@127.0.0.1:18081/repo
repoToken=GitBadPassSentinel99
useExecLogs=true

-- .env --
